Usage: jsnet <command> [options]

Commands:
  run <file.jsn|dir> [-- args]   Compile in memory and run (no project needed)
  emit <file.jsn>                Print the generated C# (what Roslyn compiles to IL)
  check <files|dirs>             Report diagnostics without generating code
  compile [options] <files>      Generate C# for MSBuild (used by JSNet.Sdk)
